entries.note: 6B47 helmet with EMR cover on a display head, front-left: shell shape, cover, chinstrap. Display piece carries a St George ribbon band, not field issue.

entries.note: 6B45 Ratnik body armour in EMR on a display mannequin, front: collar, groin protector, MOLLE pouches.

entries.author: Артём Финн (Artyom Finn)
entries.note: Group of Russian soldiers standing, front, full body: EMR (Digital Flora) uniforms, Ratnik 6B47 helmets and 6B45 vests, AK-74M rifles.

entries.author: Igor Rudenko (Игорь Руденко).
entries.note: Two Russian soldiers advancing up a slope, front quarter: EMR uniform, 6B47 helmet, 6B45 vest, AK-74M; boots and kneepads.

entries.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
entries.note: Infantry standing at a parade rehearsal (2014), several from the side and behind: EMR uniform, vest back, helmets, AKs carried. Older pre-Ratnik helmets and vests on some; parade dress, not field kit.

entries.author: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation (mil.ru)
entries.note: PLA soldier aiming at the 2021 International Army Games (frame from a mil.ru video), from behind and right, waist up: Xingkong woodland uniform (Type 19/21 cut not settled by the photo), Xingkong plate carrier with laser-cut panels and belt pouches, high-cut helmet with Xingkong cover, rails and headset (model not identified), QBZ-191 with optic.

entries.author: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation (mil.ru)
entries.note: PLA soldier aiming round a post at the 2021 International Army Games (cropped from a mil.ru video), near left profile from slightly behind, knees up: Xingkong woodland uniform, Xingkong plate carrier side and back, leg pouch and holster, covered high-cut helmet with headset, QBZ-191 with optic. Converted from PNG.

entries.author: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation (mil.ru)
entries.note: PLA soldier aiming (2021 International Army Games, mil.ru video frame), close-up from the right: Xingkong helmet cover over a high-cut shell with side rails and headset, Xingkong sleeve with arm patch and pocket, QBZ-191 with magnified optic.

entries.note: Type 21 (left) and Type 19 (right) field blouses in Xingkong jungle (woodland) camouflage, flat lay, front: pattern colours and scale, pocket and collar cut. Converted from PNG on white.
